title: REDUCED FLASHING STARTS ON
why: His 2.61 asks for a Settings switch on by default, with at most about three bright flashes a second.
now: New saves and the demo start with reduced flashing. Existing choices stay. Blast lights and lightning share a three-per-second visual limit when on.
